mil7.4.5:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, pabbatassa pañca angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.4.5:1.2: Yathā mahārāja pabbato acalo akampiyo asampavedhī,
mil7.4.5:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sammānane vimānane sakkāre asakkāre garukāre agarukāre yase ayase nindāya pasaṃsāya sukhe dukkhe iṭṭhāniṭṭhesu sabbattha rūpa-sadda-gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabba-dhammesu rajanīyesu na rajjitabbaṃ, dussanīyesu na dussitabbaṃ, muyhanīyesu na muyhitabbaṃ, na kampitabbaṃ na calitabbaṃ, pabbatena viya acalena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.5:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja pabbatassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.5:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja pabbato thaddho na kenaci saṃsaṭṭho,
mil7.4.5:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena thaddhena asaṃsaṭṭhena bhavitabbaṃ, na kenaci saṃsaggo karaṇīyo.
mil7.4.5:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pabbatassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.5:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja pabbate bījaṃ na virūhati,
mil7.4.5:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sakamānase kilesā na virūhāpetabbā.
mil7.4.5:5.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pabbatassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.5:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja pabbato accuggato,
mil7.4.5:9.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ñāṇaccuggatena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.5:9.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pabbatassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.5:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja pabbato anunnato anoṇato,
mil7.4.5:11.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena unnatāvanati na karaṇīyā.
mil7.4.5:11.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pabbatassa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.5:11.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja upāsikāya Cullasubhaddāya sakasamaṇe parikittayamānāya:
